verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's documentation shows webhooks that POST to the merchant's endpoint when payment, payout, or other account events occur. That is a developer building block: the user must write their own code to act on events. There is no evidence of a product feature for defining event-triggered rules or automated actions, so the story earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Receive a POST request from Flutterwave when a payment, payout, or other event happens on your account.
